mapper.insert: insert into setmeal (category_id, name, price, status, description, image, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{status}, #{description}, #{image}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})

insert into setmeal_dish (setmeal_id, dish_id, name, price, copies) values
(#{setmealDish.setmealId}, #{setmealDish.dishId}, #{setmealDish.name}, #{setmealDish.price}, #{setmealDish.copies})
mapper.select: select s.id, s.category_id, s.name, s.price, s.status, s.description, s.image, s.update_time, c.name as category_name from setmeal s left join category c on s.category_id = c.id where s.id = #{id}
select count(s.id) from setmeal_dish s left join dish d on s.dish_id = d.id where s.setmeal_id = #{id} and d.status = 0

select count(s.id) from setmeal s where s.id in #{id}
and s.status = 1
